blocks.text: Maple Ridge condos and townhomes: sale price, days on market and sale-to-list, May to September 2026
In September 2026 condos and townhomes in Maple Ridge sold about 6% below list price, after 49 days on market on the reports’ measure (up from 22 in May).

blocks.text: Maple Ridge condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Maple Ridge peaked at 324 in May 2026 and bottomed at 206 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in June 2026 with 64. The reported sale price moved from $585,000 to $525,000, a change of −10.3%.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 286 condos and townhomes listed in Maple Ridge and 33 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 12%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The September report gave $525,000 for condos and townhomes in Maple Ridge, against $640,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: The September report showed 49 days on market for condos and townhomes in Maple Ridge and a sale-to-list price ratio of 94%, against 28 days the month before.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Maple Ridge freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Maple Ridge?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
